references.text: Here Zilpah, Leah's servant woman, and her sons Gad and Asher are mentioned, who are also Jacob's sons.
Summary of Zilpah's descendants: 'These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah.' Total sixteen souls.
Laban gave his servant woman Zilpah to his daughter Leah, as background for Zilpah's role in Jacob's family.
The preceding verses list Jacob's other sons – Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, Benjamin, Dan and Naphtali – who together with Gad and Asher make up the twelve tribes.
Chronological connection: 30:12 describes the birth of Asher which is summarized in 35:26.
Chronological connection: 30:10 describes the birth of Gad which is summarized in 35:26.
Historical context: Both verses confirm that Leah's line (including Zilpah's sons) was established in Paddan-Aram.
Genealogical elaboration: 46:16 shows Gad's descendants who are mentioned as a son of Zilpah in 35:26.
Causal relationship: 30:9 describes the giving of Zilpah which led to the birth mentioned in 35:26.
